title: Oven Roasted Moroccan Chicken Rfissa
description: A cultured and romantic Moroccan dish featuring chicken, white chocolate chips, and spices, served in a pillowy rfissa form, perfect for a special occasion.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, ginger, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chopped onion to the bowl and mix until well combined.
Add the chicken thighs to the bowl and mix until they are fully coated with the spice mixture.
Transfer the chicken and onion mixture to a large baking dish.
Sprinkle the white chocolate chips over the top of the chicken and onion mixture.
Cover the baking dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 20 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Remove the dish from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes before serving.
Serve the chicken and onion mixture over a bed of rfissa, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
